main_body: A bare, dead gothic tree: a vertical trunk with a root flare at the base and bare branches spreading upward, with a few crows perched in the branches.
top_band: none. The organic trunk is a rounded vertical form with no horizontal top surface. The column scan shows only brown wood tones and dark outline runs.
evidence: This is an organic tree (bare trunk and branches), so the rigid top-band and front-face construction does not apply. The trunk is a cylindrical form with a root flare at the base, and there is no flat-band cap, slab or isometric side face to fail it. It reads as a normal upright tree in the same view as the reference trees, so it is acceptable for the organic kind.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 16 distinct colours against 427 and 567 for the references, and a median of 9 colours per tile against about 108. Most dark edge pixels (92%) are neutral, so the outline is a near-black line rather than a dark tone of the adjacent material. The trunk and branches are shaded in about 4 brown steps with some bark streaks, but the shading is clearly shallower than the references' 5-6 step leaf and bark ramps. There is no flat-fill coverage, but the low colour count and neutral outline make it thinner and more sticker-like than the references.
